description: Angular component for a wind speed and direction widget, rendering an SVG-based compass with dynamic data updates.

classes.name: WindSpeedDirectionWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rendering wind speed and direction as an SVG compass with dynamic data updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, data keys, styles, and click actions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Draws SVG shape after view initialization if pending.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers SVG drawing.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates wind direction and center value from data, then renders SVG.

methods.name: drawSvg
methods.description: Creates SVG compass, ticks, pointer, and labels, and sets up resize handling.

methods.name: drawTickText
methods.description: Draws tick labels at specified angles.

methods.name: renderValues
methods.description: Animates pointer and updates center value text.

methods.name: renderCenterValueText
methods.description: Updates the center value display with current data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts SVG scale based on container size.
